correctness.rationale: The exact finite-residue fibre formula follows from a uniform integral Taylor congruence for signed derangements, explicit derivative valuations v2(F'(odd))=0 and v2(F'(even))=1, and the three normalized isometries. Every isometry induces bijections on Z/2^j; counting lifts yields one odd-index preimage for each even target and four even-index preimages for each 1 mod 8 target. Periodicity supplies densities. Standalone checker verified k=3..12, 64 derivative residues and 1160 local-distance pairs; infinite proof is analytic, not computational extrapolation.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Continuity, a global 1-Lipschitz inequality, known period, and finitely many normalized binary digits do not logically give an exact all-target multiplicity law. The new proof establishes parity-dependent equality of valuations.

value.rationale: The complete image and exactly evaluated probability mass of every residue modulo every dyadic prime power is a natural exact invariant of the classical derangement sequence. Three isometric branches account structurally for a stable five-eighths image fraction and 4-to-1 fibre size difference. This all-exponent classification is not a narrow ad hoc finite slice nor merely a restatement of the previously known modulo-eight congruences.
